checks.name: No-edit native build is byte-identical to the entire source ROM
Original table loader and entry decoder agree for all 248 static locations
Canonical native edit x has one Undo and exact Redo
Canonical native edit y has one Undo and exact Redo
Canonical native edit scene has one Undo and exact Redo
Canonical native edit entry has one Undo and exact Redo
Four field edits affect only the three declared packed bytes
Original native entry and return routines consume the edited data
Project save and reopen preserve source, edits, reference World and native output
Edited native output can be recognized and reimported without weakening code guards
Unsupported art edits block native build and failure clears a previous artifact
Transient slots, travel flags, duplicate edits and invalid values are refused

limits: Private ROM input is not distributed. Native routine checks share the existing CPU instruction core and use an independent bounded bus. No full-game, hardware or audible-equivalence claim.
